activity_summary: At two you went on. John would not open a new matter. Kemp added nothing. You played, and you did not bring the morning's book into the afternoon. Nobody named a sum.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Went on, and left the morning out of it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept the afternoon to what was set down.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: I have no line to add, and I am not inventing one in the yard.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: There is nothing of the morning in this afternoon.
